name: search_cep
description: Looks up a Brazilian postal code (CEP) using the ViaCEP API and returns its address data: street, complement, neighborhood, city, state, region, IBGE code, and area code (DDD). Use it whenever the user asks about the address of a CEP. If the CEP does not exist, the result contains "erro": "true".

cep.description: The CEP to look up, with exactly 8 digits and no separators (e.g., 01001000).

name: get_local_time
description: Returns the user's current local date and time (ISO 8601, without offset), their IANA time zone (e.g., America/Sao_Paulo), and their UTC offset (e.g., -03:00). Use it whenever the answer depends on the user's current date, time, or time zone.
